label: XPS 13 (9340) ultraportable
description: 13.4-inch ultraportable, Intel Core Ultra (Meteor Lake), two Thunderbolt 4 ports and Wi-Fi 7; no onboard Ethernet.
notes: No RJ45 and no USB-A, so a USB-C dock or 2.5GbE USB-C adapter is mandatory for wired. Wi-Fi 7 (BE200-class) is the only built-in uplink - the classic thin-and-light that cannot be plugged in.
